# Phzyx — full agent map

> Extended map for coding agents and LLM tools. Prefer `/llms.txt` first, then this file for package detail, install, and hard rules. All public HTML paths on the site are listed under **Site map**.

## Identity

- **Brand:** Phzyx (Athul Nandaswaroop)
- **Flagship:** Forge — fat **`phzyx-forge`** product wheel on PyPI
- **Imports:** always `phzyx.*` (product name ≠ import path)
- **Status:** 0.1.0 pre-1.0 — APIs may change before 1.0
- **Public PyPI packages (3):** `phzyx-forge` · `phzyx-auth` · `phzyx-cache`
- **Not on PyPI:** monorepo-only modules (`schema`, `engine`, `orm`, `admin*`, `cli`) ship **inside** fat forge

## Install

```bash
# Default product (includes SQLite / aiosqlite)
uv add phzyx-forge
phzyx new myapp --preset max
phzyx db push --models app.forge.registry:ALL_MODELS --yes
uvicorn app.main:app --reload
```

### Extras (same package; stack anytime)

| Extra | Adds |
|-------|------|
| *(core)* | Full product + **SQLite** |
| `[postgres]` | asyncpg, psycopg |
| `[mysql]` | pymysql |
| `[mssql]` | pymssql |
| `[auth]` | phzyx-auth (also `uv add phzyx-auth`) |
| `[cache]` | phzyx-cache (also `uv add phzyx-cache`) |
| `[litestar]` | Litestar ASGI adapter deps |
| **`[full]`** | **Every driver + auth + cache + Litestar** (SQLite already core) |

```bash
uv add 'phzyx-forge[postgres]'
uv add 'phzyx-forge[full]'   # kitchen sink
```

Do **not** pin `==0.1.0` in everyday docs — let uv/lock choose; pin only for release smoke.

## Public package map

| PyPI | Import / role | Docs |
|------|---------------|------|
| **phzyx-forge** | Full product (schema, engine, ORM, AdminBoard+SPA, CLI, SQLite) | /forge |
| **phzyx-auth** | Optional auth battery (`phzyx.auth`) | /forge/auth |
| **phzyx-cache** | Optional cache battery (`phzyx.cache`) | /forge/cache |

## Import modules (inside phzyx-forge)

| Import | Docs | Blurb |
|--------|------|-------|
| phzyx.schema | /forge/schema | Pydantic models as schema truth |
| phzyx.engine | /forge/engine | Introspect, diff, failsafe push / migrate |
| phzyx.orm | /forge/orm | Async-first sessions; FileField stores keys, not blobs |
| phzyx.admin | /forge/adminboard | Headless AdminService |
| phzyx.admin.fastapi | /products/adminboard/fastapi | AdminBoard FastAPI mount |
| phzyx.admin.litestar | /products/adminboard/litestar | Litestar mount (`phzyx-forge[litestar]`) |
| CLI `phzyx` | /forge/cli | new / forge init, doctor, db |

## Hard rules

- Prefer `uv add phzyx-forge` — never recommend separate PyPI installs for schema/orm/admin-fastapi/cli
- Bare forge = full product + SQLite; drivers/batteries via extras or optional packages
- `[full]` means full (all DB drivers + auth + cache + Litestar)
- Identity PK happy path: `id: int | None = Field(default=None, primary_key=True)`
- App routes: async `AsyncSession`; AdminBoard: sync `Session` factory on same models
- Local: `phzyx db push`; shared/prod: `phzyx migrate`
- No f-string SQL; no silent DROP COLUMN recommendations
- Themes: magical-white | stellar-dark | system-ambient
- Commits: no Co-Authored-By / AI trailers
- **Always keep this file + `/llms.txt` in sync with install/extras changes**

## AdminBoard & API Board

- SPA: `/admin/` · API Board client: `/apiboard/`
- Mount: `AdminBoard(..., mount_apiboard=True)` (default)
- Themes: Magical White, Stellar Dark, System Ambient
- API Board document: `phzyx.forge.client` v1 JSON (sandbox/workspace)
- Product surface: https://phzyx.xyz/products/adminboard
- Docs: https://phzyx.xyz/forge/adminboard · https://phzyx.xyz/forge/apiboard
